items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: I lie in bed and listen to Big Mama Betty Rank and do her hour and a half and enjoy it very much usually.

ctx.x: Well, do the records on the radio sound anything that... Do you hear anything that pleases you particularly?
Oh, yeah. A lot of them please me, but they are not... Excuse me. You don't hear so much of the brass band sound. But I just... I... enjoy WHO's... stuff

O.Z. And on Saturday mornings, when I'm down here, I lie in bed and listen to Big Mama Betty Rank and do her hour and a half and enjoy it very much usually. And then other times when I can find, when I'm not in class and they're playing something. But it is, one of my frustrations being down here the past couple of summers is that I don't have with me equipment, you know, a simple cassette recorder that I could record right off the radio.
